reviews.review_text: I have normal skin that leans more oily throughout the day, and I didn’t realize this cream was better suited to dry skin when I received a sample of it. It is a pretty thick cream formula, which I personally do not like or need, but if you have extremely dry skin, this would be pretty hydrating.That being said, there is absolutely no reason for this price tag. The sample lasted me for a month and it didn’t do anything special for my skin. Some of my favorite moisturizers do more to hydrate and smooth my skin throughout the day and are at least 60% cheaper than this product. La Mer’s big schtick is that their “miracle brew“ is composed of fermented sea kelp; there are plenty of other brands and products that have sea kelp that are more effective and at a much lower price point. This product did not keep my skin hydrated all day, like it claims, which is saying something since I don’t deal with dry skin in the first place.If someone wants a luxury product for the sake of it, by all means, go nuts. However, this product is a great example of how a luxury price tag doesn’t equal effective results. Save your money and look into other products that have better, more effective ingredients and better price tags.

I got the mini size to test out about two months ago, since I had heard so many good things about this cleanser and wanted to see what the hype was about.Pros: It is very gentle. I don’t wash my face in the morning, but if you do, this is a nice gentle option that won’t make your skin feel stripped and dry first thing in the morning. It has a light, non-perfumey fresh scent; this might sound weird, but it smells like a green smoothie. Either way, it’s a nice scent that is not harsh at all.Cons, and why I won’t be buying the full size: It is very gentle. If I put makeup on, I double cleanse in the evening and I’ve found that this cleanser is not enough to completely get off any extra makeup or residue left from the cleansing balm. I have to triple cleanse in the evenings after washing off makeup, if I’m using this cleanser. For the price, I want this to be able to at least get leftover makeup off my face after already going in with a cleansing balm and this cannot do that.Overall, it is a very nice gentle cleanser and I do like using it when I’m not washing off makeup. I just personally don’t like having multiple cleansers when I know I can get one that does it all, and at a cheaper price point (I’ve used the La Roche Posay Toleriane foaming cleanser and the Simple Moisturizing Gentle cleanser and both are great options, get makeup off perfectly fine, and are at most groceries and drugstores).

reviews.product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
reviews.review_text: I purchased this moisturizer at the beginning and got my second jar earlier this month.I love this product. My skin type is normal and this hydrates my skin perfectly. It was a bit of a learning curve to figure out how much of this to use; when I first purchased this, I used my normal amount that I would do with other moisturizers and my skin got overwhelmed and broke out a little bit. This product is so hydrating and a very little bit goes a long way. I’ve found it a little too hydrating for my skin type during the day, so I’ve started using this as my night cream instead and it is perfect.It is very light on the skin and because the ingredients are so bioavailable, it absorbs into the skin very quickly, delivering instant hydration. It has a fresh “green juice“ scent, if that makes sense. The majority of my skin care products don’t have much of a scent, but this is a very light fragrance and I think it adds to the simple luxury of my evening skin care time.Overall, I love this product. As a general rule for me, moisturizers aren’t the skin care products I feel like you have to splurge on to get good results, since there’s plenty of other moisturizers that do the same thing at a more budget-friendly price point. But if you’re looking for a simple moisturizer that is free of additional active ingredients (Vitamin C, AHAs, retinol, etc.) and want to treat yourself, I 100% reccomend this product.

reviews.review_title: Like my skin is drinking a green smoothie!
reviews.review_text: So, I never thought I would spend 36$ on a face wash. I love face washes that come with cotton pads because I feel they really get the dirt off of my face better than just my hands (and I’m also too lazy to use my Clairsonic because I feel like I have to clean my face and that thing). But I had to hunt for a new face wash after I realized that Aveeno stopped making their Positively Radiant cleansing pads and every store now only carries their version with salicylic acid in them. I just wanted a plain face wash with ZERO acids in it. It seems like everything has acids in it for some reason and my skin just can’t handle it. I’m sick of my facing stinging when I wash it plus I wash my face morning and night (by night I mean when I get off from work) and I just can’t keep putting acids on my face that often (I don’t mean ascorbic acid either-I’m talking AHA/BHA/SA etc). Well, I found this and I’m so glad that I did because 1. it cleansed my face so good using just my hands and didn’t sting or burn my eyes at all 2. the soap lathers really really good so a little goes a long way (which helps me feel better about the price) 3. my face didn’t immediately feel tight or dry when I smiled after washing my face instead it actually felt soft, plump and moisturized which I have never experienced after washing my face and 4. IT SMELLS SO GOOD! It smells like kale with a shot of chlorophyll but somehow delicious. It just makes me feel like my skin is drinking a green smoothie without fruit! I know it’s crazy but I feel super healthy using this face wash! I also love the glass jar because F plastic. The only downside is that I picked this up in Sephora and my box didn’t come with a pump so I just pour a little in my hand which I hope won’t translate to me pouring too much. It’s no biggie since I see so many reviews complaining about the pump. I hope it’s not difficult to pour this out of the jar once it starts getting to the bottom. Also my face oil absorbed really good with this.

The mask became hard and started creasing, which made me happy that it was soaking into my skin and cleaning it and that’s it time to rinse off. It did take a lot of effort to wet it and rinse it off my face because it’s thick, then again, I’m glad that it wasn’t thin and watery, so I won’t complain much, just notifying you....the finished result was my skin feeling OH SO SMOOTH and matte. My oily skin wasn’t shiny like a glazed donut anymore! I highly recommend this product and would even buy it. I just saw the price and think it’s worth it. One of the budget friendly charcoal masks on Sephora (that actually works)!!!!!

That’s the first thing I liked about this. Most of my face took well to this. It felt slightly plump, but not greasy or over-moisturized. The only part of my face that turned greasy from this was my forehead, which is why I think this is an 8/10. I have one more moisturizer that I have to try for my oily skin to see if it works, but if that doesn’t, then I’ll go back to using this. I’ve received this as a sample and it wasn’t bad at all. Like I said, if the other moisturizer I’m supposed to be trying, fails, then I’ll buy this. All of PeterThomasRoth products are excellent quality and I’ve been wanting to try this for a long time and finally got a sample of it.

reviews.review_title: Tatcha did it again. High quality as always.
reviews.review_text: I’ve been on the search for a lip mask to use before I fall asleep. I received a sample of the Tarte Sea Jelly Lip Mask and I thought that that was gold. Lo and behold, that it was Tatcha all along with the literal gold spoon that was the winner. I just picked this up from my local Sephora. The packaging is extraordinary and the container design is super cute. It shows that the company actually respects your money. What I love is that its a really thick consistency. When you stir it with the spoon, it feels like when you stir a pudding cup, so that made me hopeful. It’s originally recommended to use the spoonful amount on your lips, but, in my experience, that’s too much. The mask is thick and it’s a jelly, so it’ll spread easily. I used just a half spoonful amount, because, remember, you want the product to soak in, not just sit on top. I included pictures of the before and after. My lips were dry and you could see all of the fine lines and textures. When I added the lip mask, it made my lips look lighter, surprisingly. Of course, it added a shine, but it did also plump out those fine lines. I could rub my lips together and not feel any flakiness nor friction. Honestly, it does have a slight heavy feeling, but don’t fret, at least you know it’s a real mask and is really hydrating, so I overlooked that. It isn’t sticky and my lips feel SO soft. Since you only need a teeny tiny amount, this jar will last you many months. I would estimate 6, so the $28 isn’t a bother to me. If you are also on the search for a lip mask, I would recommend this over the others, not only because the packaging container looks better than the other lip masks on Sephora.com, but that you could use less product  on your lips to achieve the result you want.

reviews.product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
reviews.review_text: I have very oily skin, so I bought the green colored Deep version. I already have a chemical exfoliant in my face routine, so I was looking for a physical one to use a step before it. I followed the YouTube reviews and used half a teaspoon amount of powder. I dripped some water into my hands and rubbed them together and the foam was super thick. I couldn’t feel the powdery grains anymore. I rubbed it into my face for 20 seconds then rinsed off my face. I loved that it gave me a squeaky, dull, matte face. Absolutely no shine, how I like it. Literally a smooth clean canvas. My face wasn’t stripped dry and it didn’t peel. My face was still soft, but just not shiny. I’m really happy with my purchase. This really did work on my oily skin. (Before I bought this, I wondered how the powder would be distributed. If I had to use a spoon or not to scoop it out. I should’ve known that the high quality Tatcha brand would include a sliding cover over the spout/hole. Genius! No spoon needed.)

I received this sample in my Sephora order that was delivered this afternoon. I love that the scrub was strong because I have acne and love to deep clean my pores. It has a gel consistency. This left my face really soft and hydrated. This didn’t completely mattify my face as I like face cleansers to do. Also the fragrance smelled “chemically“ made. It smelled like a sour strawberry and not as sweet as I would like, for example: a Strawberry Starburst. When rinsing off my face, my mouth accidentally opened (oops!) and I got some on my tongue. It does NOT taste like strawberries, btw. Still, I like the fact that it exfoliated my face and made it softer. I recommend this for people with dry skin and not oily skin like mine.

reviews.review_title: Use diff. cleanser w/ their Deep Foaming Powder.
reviews.review_text: I have oily skin with occasional acne. I also own some Tatcha products that I swear by. Unfortunately, this didn’t become one of those. This isn’t (inherently) a “bad“ product. This is a cream-gel that has a bit of fibers mixed in that gives a gentle exfoliation. But, for oily skin, I would prefer a charcoal based cleanser, such as the GLAMGLOW SUPERCLEANSE, which completely strips all sebum and mattifies the face, leaving it feeling squeaky. This is more of an oil balancer, that does decrease some oil on your face, but still leaves a little bit. I suppose that is fine for people who still want a slight glow, but I still don’t think it was deep cleansing enough. The first steps of my routine for my acne prone skin is the GLAMGLOW SUPERCLEANSE then I use the Tatcha “The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder“ in the green Deep formulation. I left a 5 STAR review (with a picture) of it on 20 Aug 2020. That is one of the Tatcha products that I swear by and that I will continue to repurchase.
